## Checklist

- [ ] If I touched a Quickshell plugin, it still gates on the
      `white-rabbit` theme name and doesn't activate for other themes.
- [ ] If I touched `install.sh`/`uninstall.sh`, I ran `bash -n` on it (and
      ideally actually ran it).
- [ ] If I touched a shader (`.frag`), I rebuilt the matching `.qsb` with
      `qsb` and committed both.
